rows.note: The five-bar study's MuJoCo render of tape c1__nominal, side by side: left house8i + best model (five_bar.realistic.house8i.model_live_friction_object.stiffest), right soft4 + best model (five_bar.realistic.soft4.model_live_friction_object.stiffest).
